citations.long: Separate or defined areas to prevent contamination or mix-ups are deficient regarding the manufacturing and processing operations.
Written procedures are not established and followed for the cleaning and maintenance of equipment, including utensils, used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of a drug product.

citations.short: Computer control of master formula records
citations.long: Appropriate controls are not exercised over computers or related systems to assure that changes in master production and control records or other records are instituted only by authorized personnel.
Written procedures are not reviewed and approved by the quality control unit.

citations.short: Actual vs. theoretical yields not determined
citations.long: Actual yield and percentages of theoretical yield are not determined at the conclusion of each appropriate phase of manufacturing of the drug product.
Drug products are not stored under appropriate conditions of temperature so that their identity, strength, quality, and purity are not affected.
Routine calibration of mechanical equipment is not performed according to a written program designed to assure proper performance.
Procedures describing the handling of written and oral complaints related to drug products are deficiently written or followed.
Written procedures are not established and followed for the cleaning and maintenance of equipment, including utensils, used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of a drug product.

citations.short: Changes to Procedures Not Reviewed, Approved
citations.long: Changes to written procedures are not reviewed and approved by the quality control unit.
Written procedures are not established that describe the in-process controls and tests to be conducted on appropriate samples of in-process materials of each batch.
Drug products are not stored under appropriate conditions of temperature so that their identity, strength, quality, and purity are not affected.
Procedures designed to prevent objectionable microorganisms in drug products not required to be sterile are not established.
